record.title: Acquire unit files and active application binaries
record.intent: Preserve the unit-specific logical corpus and exact active APKs before emulator work.
requirements: Commit tasking before execution. Fresh capture and host isolation; maintain only the authorized single private lease without router DNS or external routes.

Invoke adb root at most once as separately authorized, permit its daemon restart, then verify id. If root fails preserve that result; acquire only ordinarily readable files and do not improvise another elevation route.

Stream rigol and installed application directories plus relevant system startup/configuration files directly to separate private host artifacts. No device-side archive staging, reboot, remount, filesystem freeze, entitlement or capability changes.

Preserve source paths, metadata and errors, byte counts and host hashes. Validate archives offline; extract APK native libraries locally without modifying originals and compare hashes with pinned local firmware inputs.
Seal artifacts and capture with graceful statistics and preserve temporary-host rollback. Record live-filesystem consistency limits and any missing data.
acceptance: A hashed logical corpus and specimen binary comparison or precise access failure is preserved.
